div.div: Unsaved changes: New, Open and Open recent ask Save / Discard / Cancel while dirty (Escape = Cancel); Save continues only if it succeeds. Dirty = sources + tracked UI snapshot + reports differ from the baseline. Closing a window does not ask.

div.div: open fails (cannot read, not an IMT project, newer format, store locked by another process): error shown, state unchanged. A project is self-contained (store folder + ui.json, ADR 0014) and opens without the original logs; old .imtproj files still open and import their logs again.

div.div: Sessions: sessions/<label>/last-session.imtproj per window (it names the store folder to reopen) + sessions/manifest.json {version 2}; a missing or corrupt manifest falls back to scanning the folders; a v1 last session is recovered as main. Separate instances (--new-instance, safe mode) never get a recovery offer; safe mode starts without plugins and with the built-in profile.
